svg.title: Labour demand shifts right; wage and employment rise
svg.desc: Original equilibrium E1 where D1 meets S: N$25 an hour and 150 housekeepers. Labour demand shifts right by 100 workers at every wage to D2; supply S does not move. New equilibrium E2 where D2 meets S: N$30 an hour and 200 housekeepers.
svg.text: D1 to D2: 100 more housekeepers wanted at every wage
Only labour demand shifts: it is derived from
